Question: my question is wheather a real uncle (chacha) can marry with his niece (real bhatiji) please guide me according to shareiat. Answer ID: 14292 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1147/1086=B/1430) In the Holy Quran, among the women with whom marriage is regarded unlawful, the daughter of brother (bhatiji) also has been mentioned. It is written in Hidayah that one cannot marry the daughter of one?s real brother, it is haram . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
